Akutobhayā
Nāgārjuna's own gloss on his Mādhyamikakārikās. Cordier III. p. 293. [Page008-b]
According to the Chinese version, this is ascribed to Piṅgalākṣa.

Akulakālikātriṃśikā
Kāś. Śai. by Ramyadeva. Q. by him in his C. on Bhāvopahārastotra, p. 38. Kas. Texts 14.

Akulakaulikātriṃśikā
Kāś. Śai. by Ramyadeva. Q. ibid. p. 8.

Akulavīratantra
revealed by Mīnanātha; ms. in the Durbar Library, Nepal.
See JASB. (NS.) XXVI (1930) 130.
D. the above two titles refer to the same work ?

Akulāgamatantra
tantra. America 4397. B. IV. 252. BORI. 444 of 1884-86. Peters. III. 399. Skt. Col.. Ben. 1897-1901, p. 79 (no. 278).
--Q. by Sūrya Paṇḍita, Hall p. 119.
--Akulāgamatantre yogasārasamuccayah2. Bhr. 396 (inc., up to the 9th Paṭala). BORI. 396 of 1882-83. 609 of 1887-91 (?) (Ākulāgamayogaśāstra). Hpr. II. 1 (only 9 Paṭalas). IO. 2565 (10 Paṭalas). 2566 (9 Paṭalas). Mysore I. p. 405 (8 Paṭalas). RASB. VIII. A. 6113.

Ākulāgamatantra
See Akulāgama tantra, NCC. I. p. 7b. Q. by Sūrya Paṇḍita. Hall p. 119.

Akulendranātha
tāntric writer.
--Pīyūṣaratnamahodadhi. RASB. VIII. B. 6619.

Ākulāgamayogaśāstra
Bd. 609. BORI. 609 of 1887-91. See Akulāgama tantra in NCC. I. p. 7b.

Ākūtacandrikā
or bhAratAkUtacandrikA name of Ratnagarbha's c. on the Mahābhārata. TD. 8640. [Page007-b]
